title: Pass a checkpoint and continue in a new workspace
statement: As a developer invoking a Plan I decide who passes its checkpoints, myself or the agent unless something is surprising or urgent, and a passed checkpoint lets the work continue in a new workspace

acceptance_criteria.statement: Whoever invokes the Plan chooses whether they pass checkpoints themselves or let the agent pass them
An agent allowed to pass a checkpoint stops for a person when the checkpoint's work is surprising or urgent
A pass records who passed the checkpoint and why
A passed checkpoint lets the next work start in a new workspace without merging to the main branch
